decisive_spans.text: Microscopically, the tumor invaded from the serosal surface into the myometrium and comprised sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses (32 per 10 high-power fields), pseudo-rosette formation, foci of cytoplasmic clearing, and necrosis
Immunohistochemical stains showed diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1 and negativity for keratin, DOG1, synaptophysin, desmin, myogenin, WT-1, CD45, inhibin, GATA-3, and SOX-10

response.rationale: The microscopic description of 'small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, pseudo-rosette formation' and immunohistochemical findings of 'diffuse positivity for CD99' are highly characteristic of Desmoplastic small round cell tumor. While D1 mentions a 'heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion' and 'fleshy solid and cystic components, central hemorrhage, and necrosis', these are general features of many sarcomas and not as specific as the microscopic and IHC findings for D3. D3 also has strong contradict items that are not present in the vignette.
